method.cases: Actual EtlAtScale and NirvanaMaxGraphTest story render exports mounted outside Storybook manager; inactive minimap; seeded/frozen graph.
method.editOrderingDetails: Retained6 A X1, final Y1 Y2, retained6 X2. Use prior Canvas C1 C2 with the identical fixture/actions and harness.
method.edits: 8 warm-up then 24 serial edits per pass. rAF intervals counted since immediately before the edit through a 120 ms settle window and two additional callbacks, strict >16.700 ms rounded to nearest microsecond.
method.camera: 48 warm-up then 100 frames per pass per route, circle-pan and zoom fit↔0.95.
method.finalLogs: Y1/Y2 and actualC/SdiagC/selectionC/routeC refer to frozen candidateD SHA 208b3db8 from candidateD-sources; A is retained6.
method.timing: One outer backend.draw or SceneRendererLayer.drawInterpreter wrapper. Independent instrumented topology and phase probes, excluded from primary timing.
method.screenshots: Fixed-time WebGL RGBA plus HTML text/anchors/positions vs previous WebGL, not cross-renderer screenshot comparison.
method.cameraRawFields: inputToRaf is the time to the requestAnimationFrame callback. rafIntervals measures gaps between callback timestamps. Camera and action intervals are separate populations.
